head: Glucose Relay copies FreeStyle Libre readings into Apple Health
dek: In many countries LibreLink doesn't save glucose readings to Apple Health; Glucose Relay copies your FreeStyle Libre readings there automatically. It was #71 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 12 November.
details: In Health, glucose sits next to your sleep, activity and heart rate and can be shared with your care team. It costs $1.99 with no in-app purchases, by Bruce Elgort, and needs iOS 17.
means: Libre users can keep their glucose history in Apple Health with everything else.
todo: Find Glucose Relay in the App Store; you need a FreeStyle Libre sensor and LibreLink.
